4) Bitcoin's Rollercoaster:

March 2020: #Bitcoin  fell from $10,000 to $3,800 (-62%) as liquidity concerns gripped investors.

Post-crash: $BTC surged, reaching $65,000 in 2021, as money flowed into risk-on assets post-pandemic.

In a health crisis, BTC may dip short-term but often rebounds stronger.
